definition.rate_selection: first measured safe rate in descending fixed schedule
definition.execution: train-with-autograd in every loss pass; identical no-update control before search
definition.rollback: Restore each step-start before its trial; exceptions and final assessment restore the initial parent; no model files written
definition.scope: One bounded research block on a fixed shared direction, not four new network contributions or native learning cycles
definition.direction_preparation: Normalize each protected TRAIN gradient; bounded dual coordinate halfspace projection of saved two-PC direction
definition.reference_scope: Separate first-order task constraints from GEM equations 7-8; bounded local solver and different model/data, not a benchmark reproduction
definition.projection_failure: No finite-step search when returned representation violates a group constraint
definition.precision_conversion: Original public checkpoint tensors are BF16; exact FP32 conversion per linear, FP32 embedding output and small frozen parameters; no extra quantization
definition.backward_storage: Save original frozen BF16 matrices only; recompute temporary FP32 matrices during first-order backward
definition.memory_acceptance: Measure actual peak allocation in each physical GPU; no presumed laptop fit
definition.direction_source: Fixed saved three-shard two-PC direction from parent 2; projected again against current TRAIN groups each microstep
definition.parent_preservation: Each trial preserves current groups and the initial-parent ceiling with the same numerical tolerances; no cumulative tolerance drift
definition.quality_selection: No held-out measurement changes steps, rates, direction or hyperparameters; assess parent and final TRAIN-selected state once

evaluation_gate.prompt_prefix: Solve this word problem. Explain the calculations briefly, then end with a line containing #### followed by the final number.
evaluation_gate.scope: Separate research gate; no authorization to publish an expert or restart native learning

physical_test: Paired full parent/final evaluation on desktop with four maximum TRAIN-selected microsteps; no generation-based method choice
